# data/raw/ — ORIGINAL DOWNLOADED DATA. DO NOT EDIT.

Everything in this folder is a byte-for-byte copy of what was downloaded from
Dryad DOI `10.5061/dryad.n2z34tn5s`.

## Rules

1. **Never edit, rename, clean, or "fix" anything in here.** Not by hand, not
   with a script.
2. **Never write analysis output here.** Computed results go in
   `../processed/`; figures go in `../../reports/figures/`.
3. If you think a file is wrong, delete it and re-run
   `scripts/01_download_dataset.py`. That is always safe, because this folder
   holds nothing that cannot be re-fetched.

## Why this rule exists

Raw data is the one thing in a project that cannot be regenerated by running
code. If analysis code is allowed to write here, a single bug can silently
corrupt it, and you may not notice for weeks — by which point every result
downstream is suspect and you cannot tell which. Keeping this folder read-only
means *any* mistake is recoverable.

This is why `.gitignore` excludes the contents: the data live permanently at
their DOI, and `download_manifest.json` records exactly which version we used.

## Contents

Currently empty apart from this file — see DATASET_README.md §7 for why the
download has not yet run.

After a successful download you should also see `download_manifest.json`, which
records the DOI, Dryad version number, filenames, sizes, MD5 checksums, and the
UTC download time. **That file is the provenance record — keep it.**
